test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is a possible reason for young females becoming teen mothers?

options.text: Good support from family and society

solution:
The correct answer is __**Familial and societal pressure.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• When **female adolescent **becomes **pregnant**, it is considered to be between age of **13 and 19.**
 
• These young women have **not ****achieved adulthood yet**, and there are many different reasons why adolescent pregnancies occur.
 
• **Peer pressure, lack of education about the reproduction, **and** early sexual activity** are few factors that may contribute to teenage pregnancy. 
 
• Although some teenage pregnancies are **planned**, **majority **are **not**, and they have number of **negative effects** on the **teenage mother**, the **child**, other family members, and peers.
 
• Teenage moms frequently **lack **the **means **to **care **for a **child **and are unable to **maintain healthy **behaviours throughout pregnancy in order to deliver healthy child.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• Teen mothers who become pregnant while still adolescents are much more likely to **drop out **of the **school **due to their **lack **of **motivation **and **commitment **to completing education.
 
• About **38%** of **female teenagers **who give birth to child before turning **18 **finish high school by the time they are** 22.**
 
• This implies that **sizable portion **of **teen** **mothers **won't even continue on to complete high school, much less pursue post-secondary education.
 
• This results in these young females having jobs with extremely **little pay **or **unemployment **since they lack the **necessary** **skills **for future employment.
 
• Additionally, this results in inadequate living circumstances and the **inability **to **provide ****clean **and **safe atmosphere **for their **newborn child**.
